active_themes.theme_name: AI Infrastructure Build-Out — Mega-Cap Compute & Software

active_themes.best_expression: NVDA — purest expression of accelerating semis flow ($61.8M/day 14d bull rate) and the anchor of the AI capex story; mega-cap liquidity absorbs the institutional bid cleanly.
active_themes.macro_thesis: Institutional capital is concentrating into the AI compute stack — silicon (NVDA, INTC), infrastructure software (MSFT, PLTR), and the platform/ad layer monetizing inference (META, AAPL). With VIX at 15.88, bullish put/call, and SPY above 50SMA, the TRANSITIONAL regime is being expressed through quality mega-cap tech rather than broad risk-on, suggesting capital is rotating UP the quality curve rather than out.
active_themes.trajectory_evidence: XLK accel_ratio 1.715 and QQQ accel_ratio 3.323 (14d bull rate 3.3x the 60d baseline) show genuine fresh acceleration, not just persistence. Software-Infrastructure (1.992) and Consumer Electronics (2.246) are leading the doubling-up.
active_themes.adjacent_distribution: Precious metals (GLD, SLV, GDX all ACCELERATING_BEARISH) and broad commodities flipping bearish indicate capital is rotating OUT of defensive/inflation hedges INTO growth equity — confirms the AI bid is being funded by macro hedge unwinds.
active_themes.obviousness_signals: Theme is widely covered by retail and sell-side; lottery strike flow at 11.4% is elevated but not blow-off (>20% would be peak euphoria). Late-cycle awareness — alpha is in selection (NVDA/MSFT vs laggards) not in the theme itself.

active_themes.theme_name: Natural Gas Reversal — Early Commodity Flip
active_themes._stage_justification: Confirming the deterministic NEUTRAL floor with a one-notch upgrade to STARTING_TO_BE_NOTICED: a DIRECTION_FLIP_bearish_to_bullish with +0.37%/day 14d rate against a -9.96% 60d base is a fresh, statistically meaningful inflection that warrants tracking, but ETF flow breadth (0.0 widening velocity) does not support BUILDING_QUIETLY conviction.
active_themes.best_expression: UNG — cleanest direct expression of the natural gas spot flip; equity proxies (EQT, AR) lag and add basis risk while the commodity signal itself is the only confirmed data point.
active_themes.macro_thesis: Natural gas has flipped from ACCELERATING_BEARISH to bullish (+0.37%/day 14d) while crude oil and broader energy commodities (USO, BNO, DBC) are flipping the other way — a divergence that historically signals supply-side gas tightening (storage draw, weather, or LNG export demand) independent of macro oil weakness. Early-stage and contrarian to the broader commodity tape.
active_themes.trajectory_evidence: UNG is the ONLY commodity in the universe with a bearish-to-bullish flip; every other energy and ag commodity is rolling over. The asymmetry is the signal — but 60d base is still -9.96%, so this is an inflection trade, not a confirmed trend.
active_themes.adjacent_distribution: Crude (USO, BNO, DBO) flipping bullish-to-bearish frees up energy-allocator capital that may rotate intra-sector into gas; watch for XLE breadth to confirm.
active_themes.obviousness_signals: Low retail awareness — natgas inflections rarely make headlines until UNG moves 15%+. News volume and analyst coverage minimal at this stage.

invalidators.condition: UNG trajectory returns to DIRECTION_FLIP_bullish_to_bearish or ACCELERATING_BEARISH
EIA weekly storage report prints materially above estimates (bearish surprise)
14d rate decelerates below +0.15%/day for 5 consecutive sessions

active_themes.theme_name: Geopolitical Risk Unwind — Iran Deal / Hormuz Reopening
active_themes.best_expression: USO/BNO short-side or energy-sector underweight — the supply-risk premium is unwinding. Transports (DAL, UAL) benefit from lower jet fuel costs.
active_themes.macro_thesis: The Iran nuclear deal and the Strait of Hormuz reopening have resolved near-term crude supply-disruption risk. WTI crude has fallen approximately 5% to near $80/barrel as the geopolitical risk premium unwinds. This is unambiguously RISK-ON for equities: lower crude reduces input-cost and inflation-expectation pressure, eases the case for further Fed tightening, and removes the dominant macro tail-risk from the narrative. The correct read on oil weakness here is NOT 'Iran re-escalation risk' — it is the OPPOSITE: the Hormuz corridor is reopening and supply constraints are lifting. Energy equities (XLE, E&P names) face near-term margin compression from lower realized prices, but the broader equity market benefits. Transports and consumer discretionary are direct fuel-cost beneficiaries.
active_themes.trajectory_evidence: WTI crude ~$80 (-~5% from recent highs); crude trajectory shifting from HOLDING_BULLISH toward FADING_BULLISH/bearish. Natural gas divergence intact (independent supply story — not demand-driven). Broad commodity complex already fading (DBC, USO, BNO).
active_themes.adjacent_distribution: Lower oil -> lower CPI expectations -> relief rally in rate-sensitive growth and consumer names. Monitor XLE for E&P margin compression vs. midstream fee-based resilience. Airlines and trucking are direct beneficiaries.
active_themes.obviousness_signals: Geopolitical resolution events are widely covered; initial move is mostly in the commodity. Equity re-rating of the risk-on shift typically lags 1-3 sessions.

invalidators.condition: Iran deal collapses or Hormuz incidents resume — crude reverses sharply higher
OPEC+ emergency production cut to defend $80 floor offsets supply increase
